_how: Place card of Vila do Conde, built as the golden sample (Gondomar) and the Norte roll-out (operator, 4 Nov 2026: "Why don't you have school or hospitals data?"). Read by scripts/map-data/tiles.py with routes.csv, schools.csv and health.csv in this folder; SOURCES.md says how each figure was checked. The free card shows the rows marked card=1 and the chosen beach, city and airport; every row goes to the paid analysis. Prompt 68: 'arrive' is the line under the name (Metro do Porto timetable, facts.csv metro-b-vila-do-conde); 'more' is the card's last line (facts.csv vdc-aqueduct); 'camera' is the arrival flight, [lon, lat, zoom, bearing, pitch], up the coast from the Ave estuary to Marble Terrace Vila do Conde in Portas Fronhas. The photograph is the one the map already showed for Vila do Conde (site/src/data/place-photos.json; credits in content/media/SOURCES.md).
